slides.headline: Myth vs fact: AI receptionists.
slides.body: Three things people get wrong about letting AI answer the phone.

slides.headline: "It's just a fancy phone menu."
slides.body: Fact: callers just talk. No buttons, no "press 2". It understands and replies.

slides.headline: "It can only take messages."
slides.body: Fact: it books, reschedules and confirms appointments, and answers FAQs.

slides.headline: "Callers get stuck with a bot."
slides.body: Fact: it can forward or warm-transfer the call to your team when needed.

slides.headline: Make up your own mind.
slides.body: Call +1 (859) 724-5646 and test it yourself.

posts.caption:
"AI receptionist" makes a lot of people picture a clunky phone menu. Here's what's actually true.

Myth: it's a phone tree. Fact: callers simply talk, and it understands and replies.

Myth: it only takes messages. Fact: it books, reschedules and confirms appointments and answers common questions.

Myth: callers get trapped. Fact: it can forward or warm-transfer the call to a person on your team.

Don't take our word for it.
